svg.title: The calls' first tokens beside agents
svg.desc: The cumulative share of two calls' turns by their time to first token beside 12 closed-loop agent sessions, pooled over two 240 s runs of each scheduler, on a log scale with the 95th percentile marked: in panel a, with the agents' prompts fresh each turn, the p50 and p95 at 2,244 and 6,830 ms on vLLM 0.32 (96 turns), 716 and 4,111 ms with make-room (117 turns), 236 and 388 ms with make-room and the prefill hold (146 turns); in panel b, with each agent's prompt grown by a tool result, the p50 and p95 at 1,324 and 7,158 ms on vLLM 0.32 (102 turns), 615 and 1,073 ms with make-room (125 turns), 258 and 358 ms with make-room and the prefill hold (146 turns).
